comments.author: participant11
comments.body:
I noticed the latest nightly wheel (pandas 3.0.0.dev0+2752.ga885d67965) doesn't allow indexing into list elements produced by str.split() when using the pyarrow-backed string dtype.

s1 = pd.Series(...)
s1.str.split().str[...]        # attempting to access list items via str accessor
s1.str.split().list[-1]        # negative index access via list accessor

Specifically, list element access via slice syntax (str[...]) and negative indexing (list[-1]) appear to be unsupported for pyarrow string arrays in the current nightly build.

comments.author: participant12
comments.body:
First RC is released, and is on PyPI and also on conda-forge now. 

Thus can be installed with:

```
python -m pip install --upgrade --pre pandas==3.0.0rc0
```
or

```
conda install -c conda-forge/label/pandas_rc pandas==3.0.0rc0
```

Will do an announcement on the mailing list tomorrow (and linkedin/mastodon)

comments.author: participant13
comments.body:
FYI, no need to call `--pre` if you're explicitly requesting a pre-release version, the `--pre` will enable pre-releases for all packages, not just pandas: 

```
python -m pip install --upgrade pandas==3.0.0rc0
```
